scope: Main checkout scripts/manual only; follow-up inventory alongside fixes for CodeQL js/bad-code-sanitization alerts #105–107.
createdBy: Read-only TypeScript AST scan plus targeted wrapper review; no browser rigs or production edits.

commands.purpose: Find nested eval wrappers, including indirect (0, eval).
Check non-call mentions for method aliases; review found type declarations/comments only.

definitions.runtime-data-interpolation: Host-side values are embedded into executable browser source. Values may be fixed fixture inputs or numbers; this does not mean attacker controlled or exploitable.
definitions.constant-code-fragment-composition: Only previously defined literal source fragments are substituted. This still constructs source, but does not interpolate runtime input data.
definitions.constant-expressions-only: String code is forwarded unchanged; inspected callers supply literal expressions with no substitutions.
